name: Windows Settings Manager Pro
blocker: Windows Control Center pivot is implemented but fresh exact-head automation and real Windows/Stream Deck QA are still required. Wi-Fi/Bluetooth radio permissions, theme behavior, virtual desktop registry/readback, sleep/hibernate, protected restart/shutdown, external-state refresh, profile import, and physical key readability must be verified before release.
final_boundary: Pass fresh exact-head build/tests/Windows backend smoke/Elgato validation/package and the documented Windows Control Center physical QA matrix, then move Pro to READY_TO_SHIP and publish Pro before Lite.
release_gate: Windows backend smoke including radios/theme/desktop snapshot shape
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth live-state/control physical validation
Sleep and Hibernate supported/unsupported physical validation
protected Restart and Shutdown confirmation validation
Power Plan and Keep Awake external-state validation
Previous / Next / New / Close / Current virtual desktop physical validation
Stream Deck restart and Windows reboot validation
bundled profile integrity across seven device families

current_direction.thesis: The Windows controls people actually reach for, on Stream Deck.
current_direction.pc_modes: optional advanced feature, not primary positioning
current_direction.state_policy: read live Windows state where available, verify state-changing controls, fail closed on uncertainty

automated_release_evidence.note: Previous PC Modes-oriented release evidence is retained separately as baseline only. The Windows Control Center pivot requires fresh exact-head automation before any release claim.
